name: Chain of Responsibility Risk Check
desc: Checks position descriptions against Chain of Responsibility duty areas, shows who carries each duty in a coverage matrix and rates each role High, Medium or Low risk. AI reads every description, quotes the evidence and suggests wording to close the gaps.
notes: Seven made-up City Fleet and related position descriptions are checked against ten sample Chain of Responsibility duty areas by party type: keyword rules fill a coverage matrix and a High, Medium or Low risk rating per role straight away, AI can read one role or the whole set (quotes checked against the text, hand changes kept), new roles can be added with a party type that pre-ticks their duties, and the gap summary and role wording can be copied; it assumes the sample duty list is checked against the Heavy Vehicle National Law and that names and contact details are swapped for placeholders before AI, and Steps to productionise and Draft in Outlook were added.
tested: Rules mode at 1280 light and 390 dark, plus a mocked AI run at both sizes: matrix with risk column, cell to role view, override and Clear my changes, add-a-role form with party type pre-ticking, Check all roles with AI with progress and Stop, single-role AI check keeping overrides and downgrading a made-up quote, no names or emails in prompts, Steps to productionise panel opens, Draft in Outlook present, no page errors, no horizontal page scroll.
